messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN FLAGGED AS ONE OF THE NUMEROUS ACCOUNTS THAT NEEDS TO BE REVIEWED.', 'This is the last notice to indicate you as of 07 Oct 2016 that you have not yet updated your iTunes ID information.', 'On December 2, 2009, a large-scale phishing attack started and has been still going on.', 'Hello, I report that the URL below is a phishing site to Visa customers.', 'A debit charge on your current account has been placed on hold.', 'We would like to inform you that we have released a new version of Bank of America Customer Form.', "To give us time to work together on this, we've temporarily limited what you can do with your account until the issue is resolved.", 'Your online statement summary is now available to view online.', 'Your Online Banking account has been compromised!', 'We have noticed several invalid login attempts into your account from an unknown IP.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'we have detected an irregular activity on your account and we are placing a hold on your account for your protection.', 'Until we can collect this information, your access to sensitive account features will be limited.', 'We have therefore sent you a letter today which advises the steps you need to take to Click re-instate your service wit...', 'For your safety and protection of your Online Banking, your access to Online Services has been suspended.', 'You have an incoming payment slated for your account.', 'PayPal Online Department has limited your access to sensitive account features until your personal and financial information are confirmed.', 'Your order has been successfully confirmed.', 'This email has been sent by Barclays Bank UK server to inform you that your account will be deactivated within the next 24 hours due to incomplete account information.', 'Suspicious activity was detected on your account from an unrecognized device.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We provide account updates, alerts, and service notices, explaining detected activity, required information or verification, access restrictions, payments, and available statements."}
